title: Chapter 207 Eastern Emperor Taiyi
content:
Chapter 207 Eastern Emperor Taiyi

In Han Yanyu's tent of the Central Army of the Three Kingdoms Allied Forces, Zhong Yu, the commander of the Allied Forces, was receiving an extremely important person at this moment.

"Your Excellency Donghuang, I didn't expect you to come to see me in person?" Zhong Yu couldn't help being surprised when he saw the person in front of him exuding a strange aura.

The highest leader of the Yin Yang family, a mysterious figure, always wears a black mask in front of people, and is covered in a black robe, extremely mysterious, eerie and strange, no one has seen his true face, and no one has seen his true strength.

It is said that even Qin Wang Yingzheng did not allow Donghuang Taiyi to go to meet him in person, now that he suddenly has it, how can he not make Zhong Yu feel vigilant!

"His Royal Highness Prince Jing, since your army and country suddenly appeared in this world, the fate of the whole world has also changed accordingly, and it has begun to move in an unknown direction." The slightest change of color made Donghuang a little surprised, but he didn't show it.

"Oh, is that so? It has been said in the world that the Yin-Yang School and the Taoist School can observe the celestial phenomena and infer the future development of the situation according to the changes of the stars. It seems that the rumors are true!" In fact, the extremely mysterious Yin-Yang School and Taoism Zhong Yu has always been curious about schools of thought.

Stars, in ancient times, were as big as representing the movement of heaven and earth, as small as representing disasters and dynasty changes in the world, and could even be specific to a person's misfortunes and blessings.

What is the basis of his yin-yang school and Taoism? Can predict the trajectory of fate from the mysterious and unpredictable stars!

And most importantly, in some large worlds, stars often symbolize a god.

In this bright moon of the Qin Dynasty, there also appeared god-level existences such as Nine Heavens Xuannv, Xuanyuan and Chi You. Does that mean that certain stars are the manifestations of some gods!

"Everything in the world has its irreversible destiny from the moment it was born, and it bears the mission that it must complete. Some people discover this destiny, and try to constantly change and resist. Gradually, The stars-observing schools of Yin-Yang School and Taoism were born!" The mysterious and distant voice said from the mouth of Donghuang Taiyi, what kind of expression is on the face shrouded in that strange mask.

"So, in this way, the extremely active Renzong people who are now at home are some people who are trying to fight against fate!" Smiling, Zhong Yu didn't believe too much in Donghuang Taiyi's explanation, but he didn't completely deny it either. .

"That's right. Both Renzong and my Yinyang family are trying to change their destiny. In the confrontation with fate, they will constantly change and conquer it, and pursue the supreme way of heaven! As for the Taoist Tianzong, they pay attention to adapting to the time and avoiding the world. If you don’t come out, feel the trajectory of fate by obeying the fate, so as to achieve the unity of heaven and man!" In just a few words, Donghuang Taiyi expressed the two schools and their respective concepts of practice.

Donghuang Taiyi didn't know what his attitude was, and he didn't express any extreme words towards the Taoist enemy. Perhaps it is a top master in the world, on the way of pursuing the way of heaven, the affirmation of other seekers!

"The way of heaven, in the eyes of the lonely king, is not much different from us human beings. The only difference is the form of existence and the pursuit of differences! That's why he seems to have no desires and desires, and the way of heaven is selfless, precisely because he is so important to us. What these mortals pursue, they don’t have the slightest desire!” With a sneer, Zhong Yu thought of the way of heaven and the way of humanity, the pursuit of these two lofty ideologies.

Luck, they maintain their own survival, and with the continuous support of luck, they continue to advance. And because of the distribution of luck, one battle after another occurred.

"Oh, did your Highness discover some secret of the Dao of Heaven and understand it?" Donghuang's tone was a little hurried, and he had never had a clear idea about the Dao of Heaven and destiny for him who had been pursuing the Dao of Heaven all his life.

Regarding the existence of the Dao of Heaven, many schools of thought in the world have given some explanations for this, but it is difficult for each other to convince each other, because those explanations have some inevitable shortcomings and fatalities.

The only thing that is recognized by everyone is that the way of heaven has no form or form, and it is a kind of law and track of the movement of heaven and earth, which is public and private.

But such an illusory concept is the most deadly to many people who want to pursue the way of heaven, and even hold it in their hands and control it tightly.

Intangible and formless, it is just a trajectory in itself, and how do you let them grasp it and seek insights!

"The way of heaven is indeed a supreme existence, and the mighty power it contains is indeed irresistible to the common people in the world under his rule!" With a sigh, Zhong Yu remembered that in the world of the Three Kingdoms, in the world of gods and demons. The way of heaven that the world has seen, is not something that the creatures in their respective worlds can resist, even the high gods.

"Has Your Highness seen or touched the existence of the Dao of Heaven with your own eyes? What kind of form does he have? Is it really invisible, selfish? He has no desire for anything!" Looking at the person in front of him, It seemed that he had really touched the way of heaven, Donghuang Taiyi couldn't help becoming nervous.

The many years of Dao seemed to be revealing a mist in front of his eyes. Anyone who understands how turbulent Donghuang Taiyi's mood is.

As for the fact that he can only deceive himself in front of him, Donghuang is not worried. As a strong man, he has a very keen sense and observation of whether his enemy is lying, and because of the identity of the person opposite, he will not cheat. Such a tasteless thing about myself.

"The way of heaven can be said to be formless and formless, but it has a certain form. At certain special times, he will also manifest some incarnations to perform certain things on behalf of his will! As for public and selfishness, We creatures want to exist, but we still need to eat other creatures to maintain our own life consumption. As the way of heaven, it can't go against this principle of the great way, he also needs some kind of energy to maintain his own existence, and constantly Grow!" In a few words, Zhong Yu expressed his observation and understanding of the way of heaven to Donghuang Taiyi without any hindrance.

"Really? In the eyes of His Highness, being enshrined by the world and constantly admiring the way of heaven is just like a mortal, who is also entangled in worldly interests. Is it difficult to get rid of it?" Donghuang Taiyi did not Believe it after hearing it, but have some doubts.

The way of heaven, the way of heaven that I pursue, the way of heaven pursued by the practitioners in the world, is it really as unbearable as the person in front of me said?
